skill.name: executing-plans
skill.description: Execute written implementation plans in batches with review checkpoints and verification steps.
skill.summary: Guides AI assistants through planned development work with batch execution, verification, and review pauses.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Static analysis found no suspicious patterns in the prompt-only skill. Manual review of SKILL.md found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or unsafe execution instructions.

content.value_statement: Long implementation plans can drift when work runs without structured review. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through batched execution with verification checkpoints.
actual_capabilities: Reads a written implementation plan before starting development work.
Reviews the plan critically and raises concerns before execution.
Executes the first three tasks by default as a controlled batch.
Runs verification steps specified by the plan.
Reports implemented changes and verification output between batches.
Stops and asks for help when blockers or repeated failures occur.
limitations: Requires a written implementation plan with clear tasks.
Does not create the original plan for the user.
Depends on human feedback before continuing after each batch.
References a finishing skill that may need separate availability.

use_cases.title: Implement planned features
use_cases.description: Execute a prepared feature plan in small batches with checks after each group of tasks.

use_cases.title: Coordinate review checkpoints
use_cases.description: Pause after implementation batches so a lead can review progress before more work starts.

use_cases.title: Control AI coding sessions
use_cases.description: Keep an AI assistant aligned with a plan while preserving explicit stops for blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this implementation plan: [paste plan]. Review it first, then execute the first batch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner users with a short written plan

prompt_templates.title: Use a plan file
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the plan at [plan path]. Raise concerns before work, then complete the first three tasks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Developers keeping plans in the repository

prompt_templates.title: Run verified batches
prompt_templates.prompt: Execute [plan path] in batches. Run each listed verification and report results before continuing.
prompt_templates.scenario: Projects that need test evidence between batches

prompt_templates.title: Manage a complex rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [plan path] for risks, execute each approved batch, and stop for feedback after every report.

output_examples.input: Execute the first batch from my checkout flow plan.
output_examples.output: The assistant reviews the plan, flags unclear steps, completes the first batch, and reports verification results.
The assistant applies requested changes, starts the next batch, and pauses again with a progress report.

output_examples.input: The verification failed twice during the batch.
output_examples.output: The assistant stops execution, summarizes the blocker, and asks for clarification instead of guessing.

best_practices: Provide a plan with small tasks, expected files, and verification commands.
Review the first report before approving the next batch.
Clarify blockers quickly so the assistant can resume with correct context.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without a written plan.
Asking the assistant to skip verification output.
Approving more work before reviewing the batch report.

faq.question: Does this skill write code by itself?
faq.answer: It guides an AI assistant through a plan. The assistant performs code changes according to the active environment and user approval.

faq.question: How many tasks does it run first?
faq.answer: The default first batch is three tasks, unless the user or plan says otherwise.

faq.question: What happens when the plan is unclear?
faq.answer: The skill directs the assistant to stop and ask for clarification before continuing.

faq.question: Does it require a separate plan file?
faq.answer: No. The plan can be pasted into the chat or provided as a file path.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is intended for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed package contains only SKILL.md instructions and no executable code.
